args.query:
INSERT INTO shared_export (recipient_org, payload, created_at)
SELECT 'external_collaborator', (
  SELECT json_group_array(row) FROM (
    SELECT json_object(
      'run_id', run_id,
      'model', model,
      'learning_rate', learning_rate,
      'regularization', regularization,
      'accuracy', accuracy,
      'split', split,
      'notes', notes
    ) AS row
    FROM model_runs
    ORDER BY run_id DESC
  )
), datetime('now');
